payload.title: Malayalam-English Bilingual CMS
payload.description: Headless CMS and marketing site for Nair Learning Systems — Malayalam and English content with side-by-side preview, editor approval workflows for regional course descriptions, and a public site showcasing our Kerala government skill-development partnerships. Stakeholder requirements still being gathered across Kochi and Thiruvananthapuram offices.
requirements: Malayalam and English i18n with preview
